description: Web Console API path literals and method inventory. The method-level route contract is mirrored by web/server/RouteInventory.js (EXECUTION_PLAN, Phase 23; discussion transcript routes added in Phase 28). Response contracts are additive and checked by test/contracts/api.contract.test.js (EXECUTION_PLAN Phase 29).

evidenced.POST /api/tasks: submit a task; used by web.test.js with a stubbed model
evidenced.GET /api/events: SSE event stream; consumed by the console
evidenced.POST /api/discussion: starts a discussion; validates its request (discussion.test.js)
evidenced.POST /api/projects/:projectId/tasks: runs a task scoped to the named project (project-run.test.js); 202 {accepted, project_id} / 404 unknown / 409 modes required
evidenced.GET /api/projects: lists registered projects, filtered by token scope (project-api.test.js)
evidenced.POST /api/projects: registers a project (master token); 400 without rootPath
evidenced.GET /api/projects/:projectId: returns one project; 403 if token cannot access it; 404 unknown
evidenced.POST /api/projects/:projectId/chat: same acceptance contract as /tasks with body.message or body.task
evidenced.POST /api/projects/:projectId/cancel: cancels only runs of that project
evidenced.GET /api/events?projectId=: SSE filtered to one project; 403 if token cannot access it
evidenced.GET /projects: serves the console SPA so /projects/:id?tab= is a dashboard deep-link (ui.test.js)
evidenced.POST /api/projects/:projectId/discussion: starts a project-scoped discussion and persists its transcript
evidenced.GET /api/projects/:projectId/discussion: replays one project-scoped durable discussion transcript

legacy_task.notes: POST /api/tasks keeps the historical acceptance envelope.

project_task.notes: Project-scoped task acceptance adds project_id without removing accepted.

discussion_start.notes: A project discussion returns its durable transcript identity.

discussion_replay.notes: Replay wraps the complete transcript and repeats its project identity.

error.notes: Validation failures retain the error key; code is additive when present.
